body.en: Advanced Algebra forms approximately 20% of the EST II Math Level 1 subject test. The examination tests higher-level algebraic capabilities beyond EST I: rational expressions and algebraic fractions with domain restrictions, polynomial long division and synthetic division, application of the Remainder and Factor Theorems, solving nonlinear systems (lines intersecting parabolas or circles), and eliminating extraneous solutions introduced by clearing algebraic denominators.
body.ar: Advanced الجبر forms approximately 20% of the EST II Math Level 1 subject test. The examination tests higher-level algebraic capabilities beyond EST I: rational expressions and algebraic fractions with المجال restrictions, كثيرة الحدود long division and synthetic division, application of the Remainder and Factor Theorems, solving nonlinear systems (lines intersecting parabolas or circles), and eliminating extraneous الحلول introduced by clearing algebraic denominators.

label.en: Definition 1.1 — Rational Functions, Polynomial Division, and Conjugate Roots
label.ar: تعريف 1.1 — Rational الدوال, كثيرة الحدود Division, and Conjugate Roots

body.en:
Core algebraic concepts and structural theorems for polynomial and rational functions:
  • Rational Functions & Domain Restrictions: A rational function has form \(R(x) = \frac{P(x)}{Q(x)}\) where \(P(x)\) and \(Q(x)\) are polynomials. The natural domain comprises all real numbers such that \(Q(x) \neq 0\).
    1. Vertical Asymptotes: Occur at zeros of \(Q(x)\) that are not zeros of \(P(x)\).
    2. Removable Discontinuities (Holes): Occur when a factor \((x - c)\) cancels from both \(P(x)\) and \(Q(x)\).
  • Polynomial Division Algorithm: For any polynomial \(P(x)\) and non-zero divisor \(D(x)\), there exist unique polynomials \(Q(x)\) (quotient) and \(R(x)\) (remainder) such that:
    \[ P(x) = D(x) \cdot Q(x) + R(x) \]
    where either \(R(x) = 0\) or \(\deg(R) < \deg(D)\). When dividing by a linear factor \(D(x) = x - c\), the remainder is a constant \(R\).
  • Complex Conjugate Root Theorem: If a polynomial \(P(x)\) has real coefficients and \(a + bi\) is a root (\(b \neq 0\)), then its complex conjugate \(a - bi\) is also guaranteed to be a root.
  • Absolute Value Compound Inequalities:
    1. \(|f(x)| \le c \iff -c \le f(x) \le c\) (conjunction, bounded interval).
    2. \(|f(x)| \ge c \iff f(x) \le -c \quad \text{or} \quad f(x) \ge c\) (disjunction, union of rays).
body.ar:
Core algebraic concepts and structural theorems for كثيرة الحدود and rational الدوال:
  • Rational الدوال & المجال Restrictions: A rational الدالة has form \(R(x) = \frac{P(x)}{Q(x)}\) حيث \(P(x)\) and \(Q(x)\) are polynomials. The natural المجال comprises all real numbers such that \(Q(x) \neq 0\).
    1. Vertical خطوط التقارب: Occur at zeros of \(Q(x)\) that are not zeros of \(P(x)\).
    2. Removable Discontinuities (Holes): Occur عندما a factor \((x - c)\) cancels from both \(P(x)\) and \(Q(x)\).
  • Polynomial Division Algorithm: For any كثيرة الحدود \(P(x)\) and non-zero divisor \(D(x)\), there exist unique polynomials \(Q(x)\) (quotient) and \(R(x)\) (remainder) such that:
    \[ P(x) = D(x) \cdot Q(x) + R(x) \]
    where either \(R(x) = 0\) or \(\deg(R) < \deg(D)\). عندما dividing by a linear factor \(D(x) = x - c\), the remainder is a الثابت \(R\).
  • Complex Conjugate Root مبرهنة: If a كثيرة الحدود \(P(x)\) has real المعاملات and \(a + bi\) is a root (\(b \neq 0\)), then its complex conjugate \(a - bi\) is also guaranteed to be a root.
  • Absolute Value Compound المتباينات:
    1. \(|f(x)| \le c \iff -c \le f(x) \le c\) (conjunction, bounded interval).
    2. \(|f(x)| \ge c \iff f(x) \le -c \quad \text{or} \quad f(x) \ge c\) (disjunction, union of rays).

body.en: Proportional Invariance, Linear Structure & Quantitative Modeling: Across Egyptian Scholastic Test (EST II — Math Level 1), multi-step problems reduce to identifying invariant quantities—constant rates of change \(m = \dfrac{\Delta y}{\Delta x}\), conservation of total work/mass, or linear system rank conditions. A two-variable linear system \(a_1 x + b_1 y = c_1\), \(a_2 x + b_2 y = c_2\) has a unique intersection if \(\dfrac{a_1}{a_2} \ne \dfrac{b_1}{b_2}\), no solution (parallel lines) if \(\dfrac{a_1}{a_2} = \dfrac{b_1}{b_2} \ne \dfrac{c_1}{c_2}\), and infinitely many solutions if all three ratios coincide.
body.ar: Proportional Invariance, Linear Structure & Quantitative Modeling: Across Egyptian Scholastic Test (EST II — Math Level 1), multi-step problems reduce to identifying invariant quantities—الثابت rates of change \(m = \dfrac{\Delta y}{\Delta x}\), conservation of total work/mass, or linear system rank conditions. A two-المتغير linear system \(a_1 x + b_1 y = c_1\), \(a_2 x + b_2 y = c_2\) has a unique التقاطع if \(\dfrac{a_1}{a_2} \ne \dfrac{b_1}{b_2}\), no الحل (parallel lines) if \(\dfrac{a_1}{a_2} = \dfrac{b_1}{b_2} \ne \dfrac{c_1}{c_2}\), and infinitely many الحلول if all three ratios coincide.

label.en: Theorem 1.1 — Remainder & Factor Theorems, Rational Root Theorem, and Nonlinear Systems
label.ar: مبرهنة 1.1 — Remainder & Factor Theorems, Rational Root مبرهنة, and Nonlinear Systems

body.en:
Analytical theorems for polynomial manipulation and system solutions:
  • Polynomial Remainder Theorem: When a polynomial \(P(x)\) is divided by the linear binomial \((x - c)\), the numerical remainder is \(R = P(c)\). If dividing by \((ax - b)\), the remainder is \(R = P\left(\frac{b}{a}\right)\).
  • Factor Theorem: A linear polynomial \((x - c)\) is a factor of \(P(x) \iff P(c) = 0\). Consequently, \(x = c\) is a root of the equation \(P(x) = 0\).
  • Rational Root Theorem: For a polynomial with integer coefficients \(P(x) = a_n x^n + \dots + a_1 x + a_0\) (\(a_n, a_0 \neq 0\)), every rational root \(\frac{p}{q}\) in lowest terms satisfies: \(p\) is a factor of constant term \(a_0\), and \(q\) is a factor of leading coefficient \(a_n\).
  • Nonlinear Systems Consistency: When solving a system composed of a quadratic curve \(y = ax^2 + bx + c\) and a linear equation \(y = mx + k\), equating expressions yields the quadratic: \(ax^2 + (b - m)x + (c - k) = 0\).
    1. \(\Delta > 0\): The line cuts the curve at two distinct points (secant line).
    2. \(\Delta = 0\): The line touches the curve at exactly one point (tangent line).
    3. \(\Delta < 0\): The line and curve have no real points of intersection.
body.ar:
Analytical theorems for كثيرة الحدود manipulation and system الحلول:
  • Polynomial Remainder مبرهنة: عندما a كثيرة الحدود \(P(x)\) is divided by the linear binomial \((x - c)\), the numerical remainder is \(R = P(c)\). If dividing by \((ax - b)\), the remainder is \(R = P\left(\frac{b}{a}\right)\).
  • Factor مبرهنة: A linear كثيرة الحدود \((x - c)\) is a factor of \(P(x) \iff P(c) = 0\). Consequently, \(x = c\) is a root of the المعادلة \(P(x) = 0\).
  • Rational Root مبرهنة: For a كثيرة الحدود with integer المعاملات \(P(x) = a_n x^n + \dots + a_1 x + a_0\) (\(a_n, a_0 \neq 0\)), every rational root \(\frac{p}{q}\) in lowest terms satisfies: \(p\) is a factor of الثابت term \(a_0\), and \(q\) is a factor of leading المعامل \(a_n\).
  • Nonlinear Systems Consistency: عندما solving a system composed of a quadratic curve \(y = ax^2 + bx + c\) and a المعادلة الخطية \(y = mx + k\), equating expressions yields the quadratic: \(ax^2 + (b - m)x + (c - k) = 0\).
    1. \(\Delta > 0\): The line cuts the curve at two distinct points (secant line).
    2. \(\Delta = 0\): The line touches the curve at exactly one point (خط المماس).
    3. \(\Delta < 0\): The line and curve have no real points of intersection.

label.en: ▲ EST II Math Traps & Pitfalls — Rational Equations & Polynomial Theorems
label.ar: ▲ EST II Math Traps & Pitfalls — Rational المعادلات & كثيرة الحدود Theorems

body.en:
• Extraneous Solutions in Rational Equations: When multiplying across by the LCD, you may introduce solutions that make an original denominator zero. Always substitute candidate solutions back into the original denominators to verify they are non-zero.
  • Remainder Theorem Sign Inversion: When dividing \(P(x)\) by \((x - c)\), the remainder is \(P(c)\). But when dividing by \((x + c)\), the divisor is \((x - (-c))\), so the remainder is \(P(-c)\). Misplacing this minus sign is the #1 error on EST II polynomial questions.
  • Absolute Value Inequalities: \(|x - a| \le b\) translates to the compound inequality \(-b \le x - a \le b\) (an intersection/interval). In contrast, \(|x - a| \ge b\) translates to \(x - a \le -b\) OR \(x - a \ge b\) (a union of disjoint rays).
  • Nonlinear Systems Intersection Count: When solving a system of a parabola \(y = ax^2 + bx + c\) and line \(y = mx + k\), substitute to obtain a single quadratic. Check the discriminant \(\Delta = B^2 - 4AC\): \(\Delta > 0\) gives 2 real solutions, \(\Delta = 0\) gives 1 tangent point, and \(\Delta < 0\) gives no real intersections.
body.ar:
• Extraneous الحلول in Rational المعادلات: عندما multiplying across by the LCD, you may introduce الحلول that make an original denominator zero. Always عوّض candidate الحلول back into the original denominators to verify they are non-zero.
  • Remainder مبرهنة Sign Inversion: عندما dividing \(P(x)\) by \((x - c)\), the remainder is \(P(c)\). But عندما dividing by \((x + c)\), the divisor is \((x - (-c))\), so the remainder is \(P(-c)\). Misplacing this minus sign is the #1 error on EST II كثيرة الحدود questions.
  • Absolute Value المتباينات: \(|x - a| \le b\) translates to the compound المتباينة \(-b \le x - a \le b\) (an التقاطع/interval). In contrast, \(|x - a| \ge b\) translates to \(x - a \le -b\) OR \(x - a \ge b\) (a union of disjoint rays).
  • Nonlinear Systems التقاطع Count: عندما solving a system of a القطع المكافئ \(y = ax^2 + bx + c\) and line \(y = mx + k\), عوّض to obtain a single quadratic. Check the discriminant \(\Delta = B^2 - 4AC\): \(\Delta > 0\) gives 2 real الحلول, \(\Delta = 0\) gives 1 tangent point, and \(\Delta < 0\) gives no real intersections.

label.en: ◆ Why It Works — First-Principles Derivation (Advanced Algebra)
label.ar: ◆ لماذا تعمل هذه الطريقة رياضياً — First-Principles اشتقاق (Advanced الجبر)

body.en:
Why Successive Multipliers & Harmonic Average Speed Work: If a quantity \(Q_0\) undergoes a percentage change \(p\%\) followed by \(q\%\), the compound multiplier is the product of individual scale factors:

\[ Q_{\text{final}} = Q_0\left(1 + \frac{p}{100}\right)\!\left(1 + \frac{q}{100}\right) = Q_0\left(1 + \frac{p + q}{100} + \frac{pq}{10000}\right) \]

Notice the cross term \(\dfrac{pq}{10000}\): an increase of \(p\%\) followed by a decrease of \(p\%\) yields \(Q_0\bigl(1 - (p/100)^2\bigr) < Q_0\). Similarly, traveling equal distance \(d\) at speeds \(v_1\) and \(v_2\) takes total time \(T = \frac{d}{v_1} + \frac{d}{v_2}\), so average speed is the harmonic mean \(v_{\text{avg}} = \dfrac{2d}{d/v_1 + d/v_2} = \dfrac{2v_1 v_2}{v_1 + v_2}\).
body.ar:

label.en: Worked Example 1.A — Rational Expression Simplification & Restrictions
label.ar: مثال محلول 1.A — Rational العبارة الجبرية Simplification & Restrictions

body.en:
Simplify the rational expression \(\dfrac{2x^2 - 7x - 4}{x^2 - 16}\) and identify all excluded domain values.

Step-by-step Solution:
  1. Factor the numerator: Find factors of \(a \cdot c = 2(-4) = -8\) summing to \(-7\), which are \(-8\) and \(+1\):
    \[ 2x^2 - 8x + x - 4 = 2x(x - 4) + (x - 4) = (2x + 1)(x - 4) \]
  2. Factor the denominator (difference of squares):
    \[ x^2 - 16 = (x - 4)(x + 4) \]
  3. State domain restrictions: Denominators cannot be zero:
    \[ (x - 4)(x + 4) eq 0 \implies x eq 4 \quad ext{and} \quad x eq -4 \]
  4. Cancel common factor \((x - 4)\):
    \[ rac{(2x + 1)(x - 4)}{(x - 4)(x + 4)} = \mathbf{ rac{2x + 1}{x + 4}} \quad (x eq 4, -4) \]
body.ar:
بسّط the rational العبارة الجبرية \(\dfrac{2x^2 - 7x - 4}{x^2 - 16}\) and identify all excluded المجال values.

Step-by-step الحل:
  1. Factor the numerator: Find factors of \(a \cdot c = 2(-4) = -8\) summing to \(-7\), which are \(-8\) and \(+1\):
    \[ 2x^2 - 8x + x - 4 = 2x(x - 4) + (x - 4) = (2x + 1)(x - 4) \]
  2. Factor the denominator (difference of squares):
    \[ x^2 - 16 = (x - 4)(x + 4) \]
  3. State المجال restrictions: Denominators cannot be zero:
    \[ (x - 4)(x + 4) eq 0 \implies x eq 4 \quad ext{and} \quad x eq -4 \]
  4. Cancel common factor \((x - 4)\):
    \[ rac{(2x + 1)(x - 4)}{(x - 4)(x + 4)} = \mathbf{ rac{2x + 1}{x + 4}} \quad (x eq 4, -4) \]

label.en: Worked Example 1.B — Rational Equation with Extraneous Root Detection
label.ar: مثال محلول 1.B — Rational المعادلة with Extraneous Root Detection

body.en:
Solve the rational equation \(\dfrac{x}{x - 2} + \dfrac{1}{x + 2} = \dfrac{8}{x^2 - 4}\) for all valid real solutions.

Step-by-step Solution:
  1. Identify the LCD and restricted values:
    Notice that \(x^2 - 4 = (x - 2)(x + 2)\). The least common denominator is \((x - 2)(x + 2)\).
    Restrictions: \(x \neq 2\) and \(x \neq -2\).
  2. Multiply both sides by the LCD:
    \[ x(x + 2) + (x - 2) = 8 \]
  3. Expand and collect like terms:
    \[ x^2 + 2x + x - 2 = 8 \implies x^2 + 3x - 10 = 0 \]
  4. Factor the resulting quadratic:
    \[ (x + 5)(x - 2) = 0 \implies x = -5 \quad \text{or} \quad x = 2 \]
  5. Check candidate roots against domain restrictions:
    Candidate \(x = 2\) makes the original denominator \(x - 2 = 0\), so \(x = 2\) is an extraneous solution.
    Candidate \(x = -5\) is valid: \(\frac{-5}{-7} + \frac{1}{-3} = \frac{5}{7} - \frac{1}{3} = \frac{15 - 7}{21} = \frac{8}{21}\), and \(\frac{8}{25 - 4} = \frac{8}{21}\) ✓.
The only valid real solution is \(\mathbf{x = -5}\).
body.ar:
Solve the rational المعادلة \(\dfrac{x}{x - 2} + \dfrac{1}{x + 2} = \dfrac{8}{x^2 - 4}\) for all valid real الحلول.

Step-by-step الحل:
  1. Identify the LCD and restricted values:
    Notice that \(x^2 - 4 = (x - 2)(x + 2)\). The least common denominator is \((x - 2)(x + 2)\).
    Restrictions: \(x \neq 2\) and \(x \neq -2\).
  2. Multiply both sides by the LCD:
    \[ x(x + 2) + (x - 2) = 8 \]
  3. Expand and collect like terms:
    \[ x^2 + 2x + x - 2 = 8 \implies x^2 + 3x - 10 = 0 \]
  4. Factor the resulting quadratic:
    \[ (x + 5)(x - 2) = 0 \implies x = -5 \quad \text{or} \quad x = 2 \]
  5. Check candidate roots against المجال restrictions:
    Candidate \(x = 2\) makes the original denominator \(x - 2 = 0\), so \(x = 2\) is an extraneous solution.
    Candidate \(x = -5\) is valid: \(\frac{-5}{-7} + \frac{1}{-3} = \frac{5}{7} - \frac{1}{3} = \frac{15 - 7}{21} = \frac{8}{21}\), and \(\frac{8}{25 - 4} = \frac{8}{21}\) ✓.
The only valid real الحل is \(\mathbf{x = -5}\).

label.en: Worked Example 1.C — Nonlinear System Intersection & Tangency Criterion
label.ar: مثال محلول 1.C — Nonlinear System التقاطع & Tangency Criterion

body.en:
For what value of the constant \(k\) is the line \(y = 2x + k\) tangent to the parabola \(y = x^2 - 4x + 7\)?

Step-by-step Solution:
  1. Equate the line and parabola equations:
    \[ x^2 - 4x + 7 = 2x + k \]
  2. Rearrange into standard quadratic form:
    \[ x^2 - 6x + (7 - k) = 0 \]
  3. Apply the tangency condition (\(\Delta = 0\)):
    A line is tangent to a parabola when they intersect at exactly one point (discriminant must be zero):
    \[ \Delta = b^2 - 4ac = (-6)^2 - 4(1)(7 - k) = 0 \]
    \[ 36 - 28 + 4k = 0 \implies 8 + 4k = 0 \implies 4k = -8 \implies \mathbf{k = -2} \]
  4. Find the point of tangency:
    With \(k = -2\), the quadratic becomes \(x^2 - 6x + 9 = 0 \implies (x - 3)^2 = 0 \implies x = 3\).
    \(y = 2(3) + (-2) = 4\). The unique point of tangency is \((3, 4)\).
body.ar:
For what value of the الثابت \(k\) is the line \(y = 2x + k\) tangent to the القطع المكافئ \(y = x^2 - 4x + 7\)?

Step-by-step الحل:
  1. Equate the line and القطع المكافئ المعادلات:
    \[ x^2 - 4x + 7 = 2x + k \]
  2. Rearrange into standard quadratic form:
    \[ x^2 - 6x + (7 - k) = 0 \]
  3. Apply the tangency condition (\(\Delta = 0\)):
    A line is tangent to a القطع المكافئ عندما they intersect at exactly one point (discriminant must be zero):
    \[ \Delta = b^2 - 4ac = (-6)^2 - 4(1)(7 - k) = 0 \]
    \[ 36 - 28 + 4k = 0 \implies 8 + 4k = 0 \implies 4k = -8 \implies \mathbf{k = -2} \]
  4. Find the point of tangency:
    With \(k = -2\), the quadratic becomes \(x^2 - 6x + 9 = 0 \implies (x - 3)^2 = 0 \implies x = 3\).
    \(y = 2(3) + (-2) = 4\). The unique point of tangency is \((3, 4)\).

body.en:
Problem (Hard): A quadratic function is given by \( f(x) = x^2 - 4x + 3 \). The graph of this function is a parabola. Which of the following points lies on the graph of \( f(x) \)?

Step-by-Step Solution: To determine which point lies on the graph of \( f(x) = x^2 - 4x + 3 \), we substitute the x-coordinate of each point into the function and check if the resulting y-coordinate matches the y-coordinate of the point. For the point \( (1, 0) \): Substitute \( x = 1 \) into \( f(x) \): \( f(1) = (1)^2 - 4(1) + 3 = 1 - 4 + 3 = 0 \). Since \( f(1) = 0 \), the point \( (1, 0) \) lies on the graph. For the point \( (0, 1) \): Substitute \( x = 0 \) into \( f(x) \): \( f(0) = (0)^2 - 4(0) + 3 = 0 - 0 + 3 = 3 \). Since \( f(0) = 3 \neq 1 \), the point \( (0, 1) \) does not lie on the graph. For the point \( (2, 3) \): Substitute \( x = 2 \) into \( f(x) \): \( f(2) = (2)^2 - 4(2) + 3 = 4 - 8 + 3 = -1 \). Since \( f(2) = -1 \neq 3 \), the point \( (2, 3) \) does not lie on the graph. For the point \( (4, 4) \): Substitute \( x = 4 \) into \( f(x) \): \( f(4) = (4)^2 - 4(4) + 3 = 16 - 16 + 3 = 3 \). Since \( f(4) = 3 \neq 4 \), the point \( (4, 4) \) does not lie on the graph. Therefore, the only point that lies on the graph of \( f(x) = x^2 - 4x + 3 \) is \( (1, 0) \).
body.ar:
Problem (Hard): A quadratic الدالة is المعطيات by \( f(x) = x^2 - 4x + 3 \). The التمثيل البياني of this الدالة is a القطع المكافئ. Which of the following points lies on the التمثيل البياني of \( f(x) \)?

Step-by-Step الحل: To determine which point lies on the التمثيل البياني of \( f(x) = x^2 - 4x + 3 \), we عوّض the x-الإحداثي of each point into the الدالة and check if the resulting y-الإحداثي matches the y-الإحداثي of the point. For the point \( (1, 0) \): عوّض \( x = 1 \) into \( f(x) \): \( f(1) = (1)^2 - 4(1) + 3 = 1 - 4 + 3 = 0 \). Since \( f(1) = 0 \), the point \( (1, 0) \) lies on the التمثيل البياني. For the point \( (0, 1) \): عوّض \( x = 0 \) into \( f(x) \): \( f(0) = (0)^2 - 4(0) + 3 = 0 - 0 + 3 = 3 \). Since \( f(0) = 3 \neq 1 \), the point \( (0, 1) \) does not lie on the التمثيل البياني. For the point \( (2, 3) \): عوّض \( x = 2 \) into \( f(x) \): \( f(2) = (2)^2 - 4(2) + 3 = 4 - 8 + 3 = -1 \). Since \( f(2) = -1 \neq 3 \), the point \( (2, 3) \) does not lie on the التمثيل البياني. For the point \( (4, 4) \): عوّض \( x = 4 \) into \( f(x) \): \( f(4) = (4)^2 - 4(4) + 3 = 16 - 16 + 3 = 3 \). Since \( f(4) = 3 \neq 4 \), the point \( (4, 4) \) does not lie on the التمثيل البياني. وبالتالي, the only point that lies on the التمثيل البياني of \( f(x) = x^2 - 4x + 3 \) is \( (1, 0) \).

body.en: High-Speed Exam Shortcut (Egyptian Scholastic Test (EST II — Math Level 1)): When a linear system asks for a combined expression like \(3x + 3y\) rather than \(x\) and \(y\) individually, add or subtract the two equations directly before isolating either variable—this often yields the target expression in a single step.
body.ar: High-Speed Exam Shortcut (Egyptian Scholastic Test (EST II — Math Level 1)): عندما a linear system asks for a combined العبارة الجبرية like \(3x + 3y\) rather than \(x\) and \(y\) individually, add or subtract the two المعادلات directly before isolating either المتغير—this often yields the target العبارة الجبرية in a single step.

solution.en:
Step 1: Apply quotient law of logarithms: \[ \log_2\left(\frac{x + 4}{x}\right) = 3 \]

Step 2: Convert to exponential form: \[ \frac{x + 4}{x} = 2^3 = 8 \]

Step 3: Solve for \(x\): \[ x + 4 = 8x \implies 7x = 4 \implies \mathbf{x = \frac{4}{7}}. \]

Step 4: Check domain: For \(x = 4/7\), both \(x > 0\) and \(x + 4 > 0\) are strictly positive ✓.

question.en: Solve the nonlinear system of equations: \[ \begin{cases} y = x^2 - 4x + 3 \\ 2x + y = 6 \end{cases} \] Find all points of intersection \((x, y)\).
question.ar: حل the nonlinear system of equations: \[ \begin{cases} y = x^2 - 4x + 3 \\ 2x + y = 6 \end{cases} \] أوجد all points of intersection \((x, y)\).

solution.en:
Step 1: Isolate \(y\) from the linear equation: \[ y = 6 - 2x \]

Step 2: Substitute into the quadratic equation: \[ 6 - 2x = x^2 - 4x + 3 \implies x^2 - 2x - 3 = 0. \]

Step 3: Factor the quadratic: \[ (x - 3)(x + 1) = 0 \implies x_1 = 3, \quad x_2 = -1. \]

Step 4: Compute corresponding \(y\)-values:

  • For \(x = 3\): \(y = 6 - 2(3) = 0 \implies \mathbf{(3, 0)}\).
  • For \(x = -1\): \(y = 6 - 2(-1) = 8 \implies \mathbf{(-1, 8)}\).

The points of intersection are \(\mathbf{(3, 0)}\) and \(\mathbf{(-1, 8)}\).

question.en: When the polynomial \(P(x) = 2x^3 - kx^2 + 5x - 7\) is divided by \((x - 2)\), the remainder is \(11\). Find the value of \(k\).
question.ar: عندما the polynomial \(P(x) = 2x^3 - kx^2 + 5x - 7\) يُقسم على \((x - 2)\), the remainder is \(11\). أوجد قيمة \(k\).

solution.en:
Step 1: Apply the Remainder Theorem: The remainder when dividing by \((x - 2)\) is \(P(2)\): \[ P(2) = 11 \]

Step 2: Evaluate \(P(2)\): \[ P(2) = 2(2^3) - k(2^2) + 5(2) - 7 = 2(8) - 4k + 10 - 7 = 16 - 4k + 3 = 19 - 4k \]

Step 3: Equate and solve for \(k\): \[ 19 - 4k = 11 \implies 4k = 19 - 11 = 8 \implies \mathbf{k = 2}. \]

The value of \(k\) is \(\mathbf{2}\).

question.en: Find all real solutions to the rational equation \(\dfrac{2}{x - 3} - \dfrac{3}{x + 1} = \dfrac{8}{x^2 - 2x - 3}\).
question.ar: أوجد all real solutions to the rational equation \(\dfrac{2}{x - 3} - \dfrac{3}{x + 1} = \dfrac{8}{x^2 - 2x - 3}\).

solution.en:
Step 1: Factor denominators: \(x^2 - 2x - 3 = (x - 3)(x + 1)\). LCD is \((x - 3)(x + 1)\). Restrictions: \(x eq 3, -1\).

Step 2: Multiply through by LCD: \[ 2(x + 1) - 3(x - 3) = 8 \implies 2x + 2 - 3x + 9 = 8 \implies -x + 11 = 8 \implies -x = -3 \implies x = 3. \]

Step 3: Check restriction: \(x = 3\) is a restricted value causing division by zero in the original equation.

Therefore, \(x = 3\) is extraneous and the equation has no solution (empty set \(\emptyset\)).

question.en: Consider the function \( g(x) = 2x + 3 \). What is the value of \( g(4) \)?
question.ar: Consider the function \( g(x) = 2x + 3 \). ما قيمة \( g(4) \)?

hints.en: To find the value of \( g(4) \), we substitute \( x = 4 \) into the function \( g(x) = 2x + 3 \).
hints.ar: To أوجد قيمة \( g(4) \), we عوّض \( x = 4 \) into the function \( g(x) = 2x + 3 \).

hints.en: Set up the formula/expression: \(g(4) = 2(4) + 3 \\ g(4)\). Substitute and simplify: \(g(4) = 8 + 3 \\ g(4)\).
hints.ar: جهّز الصيغة أو العبارة الرياضية: \(g(4) = 2(4) + 3 \\ g(4)\). عوّض بالقيم وبسّط العبارة: \(g(4) = 8 + 3 \\ g(4)\).

hints.en: Compute the final value from: \(8 + 3 \\ g(4)\).
hints.ar: احسب القيمة النهائية من العبارة: \(8 + 3 \\ g(4)\).

solution.en: To find the value of \( g(4) \), we substitute \( x = 4 \) into the function \( g(x) = 2x + 3 \). \\ \( g(4) = 2(4) + 3 \\ g(4) = 8 + 3 \\ g(4) = 11 \) Therefore, the value of \(g(4)\) is 11.

label.en: ● Master Atlas of the 9 Main Parent Functions & Universal Transformation Law
label.ar: ● الأطلس الشامل للدوال الأم التسع وقانون التحويلات الهندسية العام

body.en:
Every algebraic and elementary transcendental model is built by transforming one of the nine core parent functions via \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\), where \(|a|\) scales vertically (reflecting across the \(x\)-axis if \(a < 0\)), \(h\) shifts horizontally, and \(k\) shifts vertically:

FamilyTransformed Form \(g(x)\)DomainRange (\(a > 0\))Key Geometric Feature
Constant\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)Horizontal line, slope \(0\)
Linear\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Constant slope \(m = a\), pivot \((h, k)\)
Quadratic\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Parabola vertex \((h, k)\), axis \(x = h\)
Cubic\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Inflection center \((h, k)\), S-curve
Absolute Value\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)V-corner vertex \((h, k)\), slopes \(\pm a\)
Radical\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Endpoint \((h, k)\), half-parabola
Rational\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), horizontal \(y = k\)
Exponential\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)Horizontal asymptote \(y = k\), anchor \((h, a+k)\)
Logarithmic\(a\ln(x - h) + k\)\((h, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), anchor \((h+1, k)\)
body.ar:
تُبنى النماذج الجبرية والمتسامية الأساسية من خلال تطبيق التحويل القياسي \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\) على إحدى الدوال الأم التسع، حيث يتحكم \(|a|\) في التمدد الرأسي (مع انعكاس حول محور السينات إذا كان \(a < 0\))، ويمثل \(h\) الإزاحة الأفقية، و\(k\) الإزاحة الرأسية:

عائلة الدالةالصورة المحوّلة \(g(x)\)المجالالمدى (\(a > 0\))السمة الهندسية المميزة
الثابتة\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)مستقيم أفقي ميله \(0\)
الخطية\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)ميل ثابت \(m = a\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, k)\)
التربيعية\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)قطع مكافئ رأسه \((h, k)\) ومحوره \(x = h\)
التكعيبية\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)نقطة انعطاف مركزية \((h, k)\)
القيمة المطلقة\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)رأس زاوي على شكل V عند \((h, k)\) بميلين \(\pm a\)
الجذرية\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)نقطة بداية \((h, k)\) ومجال مقيّد \(x \ge h\)
النسبية (المقلوب)\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)تقارب رأسي \(x = h\) وتقارب أفقي \(y = k\)
الأسية\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)تقارب أفقي \(y = k\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, a+k)\)
